title: RM-Distiller: Exploiting Generative LLM for Reward Model Distillation

bias_targets.target: LLM Evaluation Biases (e.g., Length, Concreteness, Familiar Knowledge)
bias_targets.methodology: Using the EvalBiasBench benchmark to measure the reward model's reliance on superficial patterns, spurious shortcuts, or style biases (such as length bias or verbosity bias) rather than intrinsic response quality.
